diagnostic.construction: Rejection-sample generic validation episodes having a retained bridge whose removal splits the first-block support graph into two components of at least two items. Choose an eligible target uniformly. Move its block-2 observation to the first slot of block 2, preserving slot times. Redundant history includes an identical target observation in block 1; novel history replaces that earlier bridge by another existing relation. Thus the novel target reconnects two previously disconnected groups, whereas the redundant target repeats direct evidence. Current observation, position, prefix length and suffix match. No diagnostic labels enter model inputs.
diagnostic.decision: Primary functional allocation contrast is the history interaction in global CE benefit; remote influence and write amounts/fractions supporting. Competence gates first. A within-arm novelty effect alone does not identify a new mechanism.
diagnostic.intervention: At target trial only, zero global evidence channels 34 and 37; preserve local evidence, cues, time and suffix. Compare global-only terminal margins, direct and disjoint remote queries.
diagnostic.metrics: Per episode target sum effective writes, target/episode write fraction, mean total support write, global direct and remote absolute margin change, global CE increase on target removal. Average within each network with episode-paired bootstrap. Primary interaction (novel-redundant) cost minus shared in target write fraction; secondary interaction in remote influence and CE benefit.
diagnostic.question: Precision-vs-shared and cost_precision-vs-cost differences in novel-minus-redundant terminal global CE benefit; 2x2 cost-by-precision interaction.
diagnostic.scope: Non-Liu bridge-enriched diagnostic, distinct from generic coefficient development and competence sets; identical for all six models. It does not estimate all-task selectivity or m-specific mediation.

rounding.algorithm: Independent torch.Generator on CUDA; torch.rand float32 outside compiled support graph. Uniforms allocated for every trial x neural step x batch subject x connection, including no-write steps. No conditional skipping.
rounding.evaluation_seed: 300000000 + panel_id*100000 + replay*10000 + batch_id. Panel ids: dev=1, test=2, history=3, Liu=4. Same uniforms across all models, paired histories and counterfactuals of identical shape.
rounding.replay_interpretation: Replays 1 and 2 diagnostic only, no selection or averaging to construct a new main policy; subjects and networks not pooled. Conditional variability given the same inputs and original latent state, not independent human participants.
rounding.training_seed: 200000000 + seed*10000 + optimizer_step; same seed across matched arms and K candidates. Separate from numpy task RNG and global initialization RNG.
